profile_text: With a focus on nursing and care services, this Düsseldorf-based healthcare provider has expanded its workforce by 35.3% since its baseline, now employing 23 staff members in 2024. As a scaler in the human health and social work activities sector, the company's growth is driven by increasing demand for personalized care services in Germany. By delivering specialized care solutions, the business has established itself as a trusted provider in the region.
